text:
The below is not accurate. An artificial neural network is deterministic, not arbitrary. It generates the same output to the same input every time. Because it’s math.

What makes AI models arbitrary is that AI companies stick in random number generators. That’s not consciousness. https://t.co/NKVrNWvR6a

quoted.text:
No. A concatenation of many matrix multiplications is… just a single matrix multiplication (that’s what linearity means).

Rather, a neural network is a concatenation of matrix multiplications *and* nonlinearities, i.e. a concatenation of arbitrary linear and nonlinear operations, i.e. an arbitrary operation.

So the relevant question is rather: can consciousness be instantiated by an arbitrary abstract operation?
I’d say it’s pretty clear which way round the burden of proof goes.

text:
Happy World Teachers' Day! 

Today, I want to recognize the educators who have dedicated their careers to opening doors for our children and supporting the next generation of leaders. 

For years, I fought to reform the Windfall Elimination Provision (WEP), an unfair provision that devastated Social Security benefits for almost 90,000 retired public servants—teachers included—here in Massachusetts. 

Teachers and public servants should never be penalized for playing by the rules. That is why I was proud to help champion the Social Security Fairness Act in January 2025, which repealed WEP and the Government Pension Offset. As a result, this change restored Social Security benefits for millions of public servants, including teachers, and brought peace of mind to MA residents. 

On World Teachers’ Day, I’m proud to stand with our teachers. Thank you all for everything you do, not just today but every day.

text:
When Goodyear's Niagara Falls plant closes at the end of October, about 70 workers will lose their jobs. These are jobs that have supported local families for generations, and now families are left wondering what comes next.

Niagara Falls has lost hundreds of manufacturing jobs over the last decade, and every closure leaves a hole in our community. That's why I'm fighting for every affected worker to get fair severance, support during the transition, and a clear path to their next job.

Our region was built by working people, and I'll keep pushing for the job training and investment it takes to bring manufacturing jobs back to our communities.

https://t.co/NYQ9CURG7o

Today we honor Frances Xavier Cabrini, an inspiring Coloradan whose life was defined by service.

Mother Cabrini dedicated her life to supporting immigrants, children, and families in need, including establishing an orphanage and summer camp here in Colorado.

At a time when so many of our neighbors are struggling, her legacy of compassion and service remains as important as ever and continues to inspire us all.

Outdated Medicaid restrictions on long-term mental health care have left too many Americans in crisis without access to treatment, and we have seen the devastating impact in New York City and around the country.

To accompany my Michelle Go Act and the Strengthening Medicaid for Serious Mental Illness Act, I am introducing the bipartisan IMD CARE Act, which would allow states to expand their mental health services and help get Americans out of the never-ending cycle of hospitals, jail, and the streets.

Boosting mental health and substance abuse treatment would have a dramatic impact on reducing crime, homelessness, and giving everyone the opportunity to succeed.
https://t.co/TscRgG6xm7
